purpose: Deep-link a journey card to the artist on each service. Ids, not URLs (L4-D2): the frontend composes the URL.
dump: MusicBrainz JSON artist dump, TIMESTAMP 2026-07-29T01:12:10Z (CC0 1.0, per the dump's own COPYING)
population: union of the served artifact graph-msw-tu50.bin (43dd82bb...) and both 2026-08-02-era artifacts; a superset is safe by construction and keeps a future build of either lineage covered
